_comment: Service configuration. Copy to service.json and edit; service.json is
gitignored so a real allowlist and a real bot account never land in git.
bot.account   the GitHub account the bot posts as. Swappable: nothing in
the code names it. Start with a throwaway account, move to a
real one by editing this file.
bot.token_env the environment variable holding its token. The token itself
is never in this file, and never on a bench machine.
allowlist     who may trigger a run. A run costs ~1h of exclusive machine
time and executes PR compiler code, so this is a privilege.
Extend it by editing this file -- no deploy needed.
allow_associations  escape hatch, e.g. ["OWNER"]. Empty by default:
machines      the slot registry. One entry = one concurrent run, because
the opam root lock is what serialises runs.
